{{quote|When I first slept in a saddle, Muad Cheade was Marshal-General.The man was as mad as a hare in spring thaw. Twice every day he searched is bodyservant for poison, and he drank nothing but vinegar and water, which he claimed was sovereign against the poison the fellow fed him, but he ate everything the man prepared for as long as I knew him|'''[[Davram Bashere]]'''}}
